title: Cloud SOC & Managed Cybersecurity Enterprise Agreement
description: Enterprise security agreement featuring conditional auto-renewal (renews unless 90 days notice, except in the first term where opt-in is required).

payment_terms.quote: Invoices must be paid under payment terms of Net 30 days from billing date.

price_adjustment.quote: Platform licensing fees are firm and fixed for the initial term with zero escalation.

contract_term.quote: The initial term of this cybersecurity agreement shall be 24 months beginning July 1, 2024.

auto_renewal.raw: automatically renews unless notice given 90 days before, except in the first term
auto_renewal.normalized: conditional (opt-in required for first term, then 12 months)
auto_renewal.quote: This agreement automatically renews for successive 12-month periods unless notice of termination is delivered 90 days before expiration, except that in the first term auto-renewal shall not apply without affirmative written opt-in by Subscriber.

termination_notice.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon providing 90 days prior written notice.

liability_cap.quote: The total aggregate liability of Provider arising out of this Agreement shall not exceed $3,000,000 USD.

governing_law.quote: This Agreement is governed by and construed under the laws of the State of California.

volume_commitment.quote: Subscriber agrees to maintain a volume commitment of 5,000 endpoint security licenses across its IT fleet.
